name: systems
title: Virtual systems: three anchors tick, .sys status counts them, .sys off disposes three

steps.note: Evidence 208: '.sys on' added three systems; after ~12 s '.sys status' read sample.sys.sim / sample.sys.after / sample.sys.before all at updates=626 (the sim group and ServerBootstrapSystem run once per frame on this server, so all three agree), Describe() printed groupFired=True, '.sys order' printed the Before/After lists, and '.sys off' disposed 3.
Start from a known state. If the demo is off this replies 'not on' and nothing is asserted.

steps.expectLog: Sample sys: Added 3 virtual systems: sample\.sys\.sim \(VirtualSystemAnchor\.AfterSimulation, order 0\), sample\.sys\.after \(AddAfter<ServerBootstrapSystem>, order 10\), sample\.sys\.before \(AddBefore<ServerBootstrapSystem>, order 10\)

steps.note: Twelve seconds, the wait evidence 208 used, so every counter is well past zero.

steps.expectLog: Sample sys: Demo is on\. sample\.sys\.sim \(VirtualSystemAnchor\.AfterSimulation\) updates=[1-9]\d*; sample\.sys\.after \(AddAfter<ServerBootstrapSystem>\) updates=[1-9]\d*; sample\.sys\.before \(AddBefore<ServerBootstrapSystem>\) updates=[1-9]\d*\.
Sample sys: Disposed 3 virtual system handle\(s\)
